provider_id.hint: Leave empty to use the current session provider.

cleanup_github_cache_after_analysis.description: Clean GitHub clone cache after analysis
cleanup_github_cache_after_analysis.hint: When enabled, only the cloned source cache is removed after a GitHub analysis job. Graph artifacts are kept in plugin data.

github_command_timeout_seconds.description: GitHub source command timeout in seconds
github_command_timeout_seconds.hint: Limits each git ls-remote, clone, fetch, and checkout command during GitHub source preparation. Increase only for very large repositories or slow networks.

max_concurrent_jobs.hint: Large analyses can consume model tokens and CPU. Keep this low unless the host has enough resources.

max_parallel_file_agents.description: Maximum parallel file-analyzer SubAgents per analysis job
max_parallel_file_agents.hint: Controls batch-level SubAgent concurrency inside one /understand job.

max_parallel_article_agents.description: Maximum parallel article-analyzer SubAgents per knowledge job
max_parallel_article_agents.hint: Controls batch-level SubAgent concurrency inside one /understand-knowledge job.

subagent_provider_id.description: AstrBot chat provider ID for Understand Anything SubAgents
subagent_provider_id.hint: Leave empty to reuse provider_id, then the current session provider.

output_locale.description: Output language for generated Understand Anything content
output_locale.hint: Auto follows the WebUI/API locale when available, then the chat message language after ignoring commands, URLs, and code identifiers, then Simplified Chinese.

auto_build.description: Automatically repair missing bundled runtime dependencies
auto_build.hint: When enabled, the first use can run pnpm install/build inside the plugin's understand-anything directory if dependencies or dist files are missing.

auto_update_poll_interval.hint: 0 disables background polling. Set this to a practical minute-level interval, such as 30 or 60, to check enabled projects for new Git commits.

default_write_mode.hint: Understand Anything writes graph files into the target project.
